items.source: This method can be especially useful when working with method references. It allows you to easily convert a method that throws a checked exception into an instance compatible with a regular Consumer.
items.translation: 此方法在使用方法引用时特别有用。它允许您将抛出受检异常的方法轻松转换为与常规 Consumer 兼容的实例。

items.source: Return a new ThrowingConsumer where the accept(Object) method wraps any thrown checked exceptions using the given exceptionWrapper.
items.translation: 返回一个新的ThrowingConsumer，其中accept(Object)方法使用给定的exceptionWrapper包装任何抛出的受检异常。

items.source: Default Consumer.accept(Object) that wraps any thrown checked exceptions (by default in a RuntimeException).
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用 `Consumer.accept(Object)` 包装任何抛出的受检异常（默认包装为 `RuntimeException`）。

items.source: Lambda friendly convenience method that can be used to create a ThrowingConsumer where the accept(Object) method wraps any checked exception thrown by the supplied lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: Lambda 友好的便捷方法，可用于创建ThrowingConsumer，其中accept(Object)方法会包装由提供的 Lambda 表达式或方法引用抛出的任何受检异常。
